vardhana.note: Boundary data describe Harsha’s empire, not the earlier Pushyabhuti rulers.

sangama.note: Vijayanagara polity boundaries are assigned to the Sangama phase by the timeline dates.

tuluva.note: Vijayanagara polity boundaries are assigned by timeline dates. They do not distinguish late Tuluva and Aravidu claimants.

aravidu.note: Only the brief overlap with the source’s Vijayanagara polity is available. Shared geometry does not distinguish claimant territories.

shah-mir.note: Kashmir sultanate boundaries are assigned to this house using the timeline dates.

chak.note: Kashmir sultanate boundaries are assigned to this house using the timeline dates.

company.note: Source British Empire polygons during the company-rule phase. Dependencies may be included.

british-raj.note: Uses British Empire for the 1858 transition and British Raj thereafter. Direct administration and paramountcy are not separately encoded.
